role: Watch-local Dynamic Type helper: a view modifier that applies a fixed-point system font whose size scales with the watch's text-size setting via @ScaledMetric.
types: WatchScaledSystemFont: struct (private ViewModifier) — holds the @ScaledMetric size and applies Font.system
toplevel: Header comment (1-29) explains the deliberate duplication of the iOS ScaledFont.swift because the Watch target compiles only its own folder.

flags.text: Re-implements the iOS app's ScaledFont helper on purpose (documented at WatchScaledFont.swift:13-23); two copies of the same scaling rule must be kept in step by hand.

units.does: Returns content.modifier(WatchScaledSystemFont(...)) with the given base size, weight, design, monospaced-digit flag and text style to scale relative to.
Initialises the modifier: wraps size in ScaledMetric(wrappedValue: size, relativeTo: textStyle) and stores weight, design and monospacedDigit.
Applies Font.system(size: scaled size, weight, design) to the content, made monospacedDigit when requested.
